name: Schwalmtal (North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and blue, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Schwalmtal (a saint on yellow and three blue bars on white).
history: The three blue bars on silver in the rear half of the arms are taken from a seal of 1267 of the lords of Ambere.

features.role: Schwalmtal arms — saint and three bars
